EHI Export Data Dictionary This Data Dictionary (“dictionary”) is the sole property of Modernizing Medicine, Inc. ("ModMed"). By accessing or using the dictionary you hereby agree to maintain the dictionary and its contents in conﬁdence and to not share the dictionary or any of its contents with any third parties without prior written authorization from ModMed. Document purpose This dictionary describes the tables and columns contained in the ModMed EHI Single Patient dataset. Refer to the training manual for more detailed usage information. When using this data dictionary, please note the following: ● Practice Management (PM) tables and columns are included in the dataset and will be empty for practices not using PM. ● All date/timestamp ﬁelds are recorded using UTC time, unless the ﬁeld has the "_ld" suﬃx. ● In ﬁelds with the "_ld" suﬃx" the date/time was converted to local time using the time zone value for the record (facility or user time zone). ● String type columns with an unrestricted length (equivalent to text and long text types) will have a value of -1 in the Field Length column of the Data Dictionary sheet. 3
The following groups are used to logically organize tables: Lookup Static lookup tables for medical and industry codes Practice Practice/ﬁrm information, including facilities and staff members. Document Management Log of ﬁle attachments, including those not assigned to a patient. Physical attachments are excluded Oﬃce Flow Facility_resource, facility_resource_detail, and facility_resource_utilization_log to track patient ﬂow in the oﬃce. Patient Patient demographic and clinical information not captured as part of visit-related data (see below groupings for visit-related data.) eLab Electronic lab orders and results. Pathology Log of biopsies and results. Prescription Prescriptions Ophth Pretesting Pretesting tests and measurement sets for Ophthalmology Appointment Appointment data, including waitlist and reminders (PM only). Visit Visit-related data that describe the visit as a whole or are not part of an individual component (i.e. HPI, Diagnosis). CC/HPI Chief Complaints/History of Present Illness Exam Exams in the Virtual Exam Room Diagnosis Findings/Impression in the Virtual Exam Room Procedure Procedures/Plans in the Virtual Exam Room PM Financials Financial tables related to Practice Management Inventory Inventory information, including products, packages, package sales, stock and patient charges for products Longitudinal Tracking Some tables do not track data longitudinally (i.e. change history), this is captured in the "Longitudinal tracking" column Y Longitudinally tracked - new row(s) for each visit (or item), once a visit is ﬁnalized cannot be modiﬁed. N Not tracked over time, data is the most recent information as of when the data was exported. L New entry for each item, but changes to the item are not tracked over time (data is the most recent information as of when the data was exported). S Static lookup table 4
